description_sq:
QIRA APARTAMENT 2+1 STACIONI TRENIT!
Jepet me qira apartament 2+1 në zonën e Stacionit të Trenit, tek BKT

Ideal për ata që kërkojnë komoditet dhe pozicion praktik në qytet.

title_en: ✨Apartment 2+1 for rent | 📍Train Station | 💶REQUIRES ONE YEAR PREPAYMENT
description_en: APARTMENT FOR RENT 2+1 TRAIN STATION! 2+1 apartment for rent in the area of ​​the Train Station, at BKT. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of an existing building and has an area of ​​about 81 m². It is organized in a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom, balcony. It is offered comfortably furnished, suitable for family or couple living. The area is accessible and close to main services, urban transport and daily facilities. Ideal for those looking for comfort and a practical position in the city. 📌 ONE YEAR PREPAYMENT REQUIREMENTS 💶600€/month
